Size B 750 (C 900, D 1200 also tabled; no A): side 750 drawn as the bounding square 1060.66, r 50, yellow edge 10 + black border 20. The sheet's vectors are to scale; table B: d 400, e 80, f 132, g 188, h 88, k 330. Symbol: the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-13-q01-2_legend.svg, items 104-134), placed as the sheet draws it: 792.4 x 792.4 with its box 396.0 left / 396.4 right of the vertical centreline and 396.2 above / 396.2 below the horizontal centreline.
